leads.name: Sweep & Reverse | Liquidity Sweep Reversal Strategy
leads.economic_rationale: Exploits stop-run liquidity sweeps beyond confirmed structural pivot highs/lows during active London/NY overlap hours, capturing mean reversion once trapped breakout stops are absorbed.
leads.counterparty_mechanism: Breakout stop orders resting above prior swing highs and below prior swing lows provide forced liquidity to mean-reverting dealers when price wicks through and closes back inside the range.
leads.entry_rule: Identify confirmed swing levels via ta.pivothigh/pivotlow(7, 7) aged <= 150 bars with min spacing 0.25*ATR(14). Trigger sweep when bar wicks beyond level and closes back inside, with wick/body >= 1.5, volume > 1.3*SMA(volume, 20), within 1200-1600 exchange session, plus next-bar confirmation closing beyond sweep midpoint; risk distance must be >= 0.5*ATR(14).
leads.exit_rule: Hard stop loss beyond sweep wick, fixed 1.5R take-profit target, and automatic stop move to breakeven once price reaches 50% of distance to TP.
leads.stop_loss_rule: Explicit hard stop at sweep wick extreme +/- 1.2*ATR(14) (min risk 0.5*ATR(14)), moving to breakeven at 50% of TP.
leads.take_profit_rule: Explicit limit target at 1.5x stop-loss risk distance (1.5R).

leads.name: Strategy_500 - Turtle Soup NY V5 M5 Sweep
leads.economic_rationale: Captures New York cash-open stop-hunt manipulation beyond the 06:00-08:59 ET pre-market range, fading the failed sweep back toward the opposite boundary of the pre-NY range.
leads.counterparty_mechanism: Pre-market range breakout buyers/sellers entering on the NY open sweep get trapped when order flow fails to sustain outside the 06:00-08:59 ET boundary, forcing unwind flows back across the range.
leads.entry_rule: Build NY pre-session high/low range across 06:00-08:59 America/New_York. During 09:00-12:00 ET, arm long after a sweep of rangeLow (or short after sweeping rangeHigh), then enter on a subsequent M5 Turtle Soup reclaim bar (low < low[1], close > low[1], close > open for long; symmetric for short) only when implied reward-to-risk to opposite range boundary >= 1.0; max 1 trade per session.
leads.exit_rule: Hard stop loss beyond manipulation extreme plus slBuffer (default 2.0 points) and limit TP at opposite pre-NY range boundary.
leads.stop_loss_rule: Explicit hard stop at min(manipulationLow, low) - slBuffer (long) or max(manipulationHigh, high) + slBuffer (short).
leads.take_profit_rule: Explicit limit target at opposite boundary of the 06:00-08:59 NY range (gated by RR >= 1.0).

leads.name: Turtle soup plus one
leads.economic_rationale: Implements Linda Raschke's Turtle Soup Plus One daily false-breakout reversal: systematic 20-day Donchian breakout chasers suffer immediate adverse selection when the prior extreme is aged >= 4 bars and price snaps back inside the 20-day range.
leads.counterparty_mechanism: Classic 20-day channel trend-followers place entry stops at 20-bar extremes; when breakout follow-through fails on the next session, their stop-outs fuel a sharp multi-day mean-reversion leg.
leads.entry_rule: Compute prevHigh = highest(high[4], 16) and smallPeriodHigh = highest(high[1], 3) (symmetric for lows). When a bar breaks and closes beyond prevHigh while prevHigh > smallPeriodHigh (prior 20-bar extreme at least 4 bars old), place a next-bar stop-entry order back inside at prevHigh (short) or prevLow (long).
leads.exit_rule: Hard protective stop at signal bar high[1] (short) or low[1] (long); once profitable after takeProfitBars, scale out half position and manage the remainder with a 5% trailing stop.
leads.stop_loss_rule: Explicit hard protective stop order at prior breakout bar extreme (high[1] for shorts, low[1] for longs).
leads.take_profit_rule: Partial 50% scale-out on first profitable close plus 5% trailing stop on remaining position.

leads.name: Swing Failure Reversal Strategy
leads.economic_rationale: Identifies Swing Failure Pattern (SFP) exhaustion spikes extending past 40-bar extremes by a timeframe-scaled percentage buffer that immediately reject with an opposite-colored candle close.
leads.counterparty_mechanism: Late momentum traders chasing stretched extensions beyond 40-bar highs/lows exhaust marginal buying or selling pressure, reverting price back toward the 75-period EMA equilibrium.
leads.entry_rule: Compute 40-bar prior extreme hh = highest(high[1], 40) and ll = lowest(low[1], 40) scaled by a timeframe-adaptive multiplier (0.3% M5, 0.7% M15, 1.0% H1, 3.0% H4). Enter Short on first bar where high > hh*(1+mult) and close < open; enter Long on first bar where low < ll*(1-mult) and close > open.
leads.exit_rule: Close Long when high >= EMA(close, 75); close Short when low <= EMA(close, 75).
leads.stop_loss_rule: NOT_DISCLOSED
leads.take_profit_rule: Dynamic mean-reversion target at EMA(close, 75).

leads.counterparty_mechanism: In low-ADX range regimes, short-term order-flow imbalances push price outside Keltner bands without institutional follow-through, allowing passive mean-reversion capture across the channel.
leads.entry_rule: Compute Keltner Channel EMA(close, 20) +/- 2.0*ATR(10) and ADX(14). Require weak-trend regime ADX(14) < 25. Enter Long on ta.crossover(close, lowerChannel); enter Short on ta.crossunder(close, upperChannel).

leads.stop_loss_rule: Explicit hard stop at close - 0.5*(upperChannel - lowerChannel) for longs and close + 0.5*(upperChannel - lowerChannel) for shorts.
leads.take_profit_rule: Explicit limit take profit at opposite Keltner Channel boundary (upperChannel for long, lowerChannel for short).

leads.counterparty_mechanism: Short-term profit-taking creates temporary counter-trend retracements beneath the smoothed trend curve; when institutional trend buyers resume and ADX rises above 20, counter-trend shorts cover into the impulse.

leads.economic_rationale: Avoids breakout chasing by waiting for confirmed price retracements to EMA(50) inside an EMA(50)/EMA(200) trend regime, entering only when above-average volume and RSI confirm pullback resumption.
leads.counterparty_mechanism: Mean-reverting intraday sellers fade into EMA(50) support during an uptrend; when institutional demand re-absorbs supply with volume > 20-bar average, counter-trend positions stop out.
leads.entry_rule: Require EMA(50) > EMA(200) for long (EMA(50) < EMA(200) for short), prior bar pullback touching/crossing EMA(50) (low[1] <= emaF[1] or close[1] < emaF[1]), current confirmed bar closing back above EMA(50), volume > SMA(volume, 20), and RSI(14) > 40 for longs (< 60 for shorts), evaluated on barstate.isconfirmed.
leads.exit_rule: Hard stop loss at 5-bar swing extreme padded by 0.5*ATR(14) and hard limit target at 2.5*ATR(14).
leads.stop_loss_rule: Explicit hard stop at ta.lowest(low, 5) - 0.5*ATR(14) (long) or ta.highest(high, 5) + 0.5*ATR(14) (short).
leads.take_profit_rule: Explicit limit take profit at close +/- 2.5*ATR(14).

leads.counterparty_mechanism: Pullbacks deep enough to push MACD below zero inside a primary uptrend flush weak trend longs before institutional trend flows re-enter at discounted valuations.

Enter Long on ta.crossover(t3, t3[1]) and val > 0 and sqzOff; enter Short on ta.crossunder(t3, t3[1]) and val < 0 and sqzOff.
leads.exit_rule: Position reverses on opposite adaptive T3 slope turn under squeeze-off momentum alignment.
